invariants: An approval is immutable evidence for exactly one authenticated Memory Core request and cannot widen its actor, scope, operation, resource, purpose, data class, environment, authority snapshot, or policy decision.
The requester and approver are distinct; an approval role is accepted only when the exact current policy decision requires that role.

Unknown, future, expired, pre-authority, scope-mismatched, actor-mismatched, operation-mismatched, resource-mismatched, data-class-mismatched, purpose-mismatched, authority-mismatched, or policy-mismatched approval evidence is denied.

An approval never creates authority, policy, scope, a Memory Transition Gate permission, or atomic audit evidence. S1-06.3 current-authority and policy evidence validation remains independently required.

The Memory Transition Gate remains the sole writer of protected Memory Core state; no disclosure, promotion, deletion, Goal, Action, external effect, or later Memory Core capability is enabled by this contract.
persistence: No persistence or approval-channel runtime is claimed. A future authenticated channel and Gate integration require separately accepted contracts and atomic audit evidence.
